create_experiment_cifar10: create an xmanager experiment for cifar10 training with xm_local.create_experiment
build_python_container: build a python container with xm.PythonContainer for cifar10 entrypoint and pytorch-xla base image
package_executable: package an executable with xm.Packageable and experiment.package for cifar10 training job
run_job_group: run a job group with xm.Job and xm_local.Vertex executor for cifar10 with gpu or tpu requirements
define_hyperparameter_trials: define hyperparameter trials with batch sizes and learning rates using itertools.product
